# Drawer

Side panel on native for details and edit forms without leaving the list.

`KenosUI.Drawer` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Drawer open onOpenChange={…}>…</KenosUI.Drawer>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Drawer" open="{{yes}}" on-open-change="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Side panel (details, edit forms) on native <dialog>.
